headline: Ankle-high ESE dribble on a prime angle — technically the good direction, none of the size.
today: The ESE line is exactly the angle Rockaway wants, but at under a foot it's just clean ripples. Dawn N offshore into a cross-off morning keeps it glassy before the SE cross-on fills in this afternoon. If you paddle out, make it a morning log session and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Real size shows — 2.6-4.4ft on the prime ESE angle, and though it's short-period (5s) windswell, morning-through-evening NW offshore cleans it up. Best day of the stretch, grab a shortboard or fish.
Follow-up day: chest-high leftovers at short period with N offshore in the morning. Groveler-fun early before the S onshore ruins it midday.
SSE onshore ramps to 15-17mph by afternoon — junked out after any early window.
